coordinates.body_side_names: Subject anatomical left/right, not viewer left/right

normalization.measure: Actual primary imported bust bbox after explicit source orientation; apply one uniform scale to all assemblies

camera_runtime.fit: Fit actual combined bbox including props/hands; never assume source dimensions

semantic_binding: Prefer the v4 canonical object names. For an existing skin rig preserve hierarchy and expose runtimeBindings mapping semantic names to actual unique glTF bone/node names; the runtime must resolve these aliases.

eyes.geometry: Each Gaze group contains a complete curved eyeball with iris/pupil appearance on the globe or co-spherical surfaces. The pivot is the actual eyeball center. No planar iris on top of painted face eyes.
eyes.closure: Use actual eyelid skin bones or measured BlinkLeft/BlinkRight morphs. Do not reuse v4 scale-y cover patches.

hands.geometry: Real downloaded Meshy hand geometry, five distinct anatomical fingers and a connected palm/wrist; no old procedural hand substitution.
hands.left_action: Natural grip -> release fingers -> apple flight -> catch -> close grip. Finger motion must come from weighted bones or actual blendshapes.
hands.right_action: Phone stays seated against thumb/fingers and palm; preserve visible natural finger lengths.
hands.grip_binding: Map actual weighted bones for all five fingers, or a real hand morph affecting all five. Record grip, half-open, open and catch evidence.

contacts.note: Set these anchors on observed actual surfaces after import. Empty anchors without measurements are not evidence of contact.

face.implementation: Actual morphs or weighted facial bones; record object/bone/key/range and validation evidence. Names alone are insufficient.
face.geometry: Teeth and tongue remain behind the real lip opening. Neutral mouth texture must not show through or above the open mouth.
face.labels: Small thick paper decals or curved meshes with readable fitted text; no unexplained floating signs or baked-only interaction text.

AppleReleaseCatch.implementation: Existing clip or explicit runtime driver, with measured release/catch times and five-finger deformation; preserve world pose across detach/reattach

BreadBite.implementation: Actual lip/jaw movement and bread contact, not only visibility switching

PhoneFlash.implementation: Flash appears at actual phone LED; phone stays in natural grip

FaceSilly.implementation: Real open lips, tongue and independent wink

FaceGrin.implementation: Real smile/open lips and teeth behind lip rim

initial_visibility_note: glTF does not preserve Blender hide_render. Runtime must explicitly apply initial visibility; verify startup after load.

budget.initial_meshopt: Lossless only, preserve source bytes after decode
budget.texture_changes: Explicit per-image plan after original PBR visual review; no global v4 material overrides
